dialogue.content: （こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。お時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きます。）
dialogue.English: (Hello. Thank you for being here today. We'll begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: (こんにちは。こちらこそよろしくお願いします。)
dialogue.English: (Hello. Thank you for having me.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢、性別、本日の相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 14歳、女の子です
dialogue.English: I'm 14 years old, and I'm a girl.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。中学生さんですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. Are you in middle school?

dialogue.content: はい、中学2年生
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm in my second year of middle school.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどんなことをお話ししたいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: いじめです、、、
dialogue.English: It's about bullying...

dialogue.content: いじめで悩んでいるんですね。お話ししに来てくれてありがとうございます。あなたがいじめを受けていると感じているということですか？
dialogue.English: So, you're struggling with bullying. Thank you for coming to talk about it. Do you feel that you are being bullied?

dialogue.content: 感じているというより実際に色々言われたりしてます。
dialogue.English: It's more than a feeling; people are actually saying things to me.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうなんですね。色々と言われたりしているのですね。それは辛いですよね。。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I see. So people have been saying various things to you. That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんなことを言われたりしますか？少しお話し辛いかもしれないのですが、教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things have they been saying? I know it might be difficult to talk about, but could you tell me?

dialogue.content: もともと学年上がって友だちとクラス分かれて一人だけ友だちいたけど、最近無視されてます。
dialogue.English: When I moved up a grade, I was separated from my friends, and I only had one friend in my new class, but lately, I've been getting ignored.

dialogue.content: ばい菌とか触りたくないとかくさいとか、、、
dialogue.English: They say things like "you're a germ," "I don't want to touch you," or "you smell..."

dialogue.content: ちょっと違うことをするとあいつおかしいって、、、
dialogue.English: And if I do something a little different, they say, "She's weird..."

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはひどい言葉ですね。。。1年生の時に仲の良かったお友達と離れてしまって、一緒になった子からも無視されているんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Those are really hurtful words. You were separated from the close friends you had in your first year, and even the one classmate you were with is ignoring you, right?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 何人かの人から無視されたり言われたりするのですか？
dialogue.English: Are there several people who ignore you or say things to you?

dialogue.content: はい、一応中立の人もいるけど表たって私と会話しないしくらすのほぼほぼって感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, there are some people who are neutral, I guess, but they don't talk to me openly, so it feels like it's pretty much the whole class.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、それは辛いですね。。。いつ頃からですか？学年が上がってすぐだったのかな？
dialogue.English: I see... that must be so difficult. When did this start? Was it right after you moved up a grade?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですか？お話し続けられそうですか？
dialogue.English: Are you okay? Do you feel able to continue talking?

dialogue.content: もともと小学校からいじめられてて中学上がったころは落ち着いたのですが
dialogue.English: I was bullied in elementary school, too, and it had settled down when I started middle school, but...

dialogue.content: 1年生のクラスにいわいるいじめっ子が2人いてそこから徐々にエスカレートしていって友だちがいたからまだ平気だったけど
dialogue.English: There were two bullies, so to speak, in my first-year class, and it gradually escalated from there. It was still okay because I had my friend, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 2年生で友だちいなくなって自然教室で同じ班の人たちに目を付けられました。
dialogue.English: In my second year, I didn't have my friend anymore, and the people in my group during our nature field trip started targeting me.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。辛かったこれまでのことを教えてくれてありがとうございます。中学になってなくなったいじめが、また始まってしまったとなると不安も悲しい気持ちも大きいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened. Thank you for telling me about these painful experiences. It must be incredibly distressing and sad for the bullying to start again after it had stopped in middle school.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は学校には行っているのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you going to school now?

dialogue.content: 夏休みが終わって言ってます
dialogue.English: Since summer vacation ended, I've been going.

dialogue.content: 行ってます
dialogue.English: I've been going.

dialogue.content: そうですか。。辛い気持ちを押さえて頑張っていっているのですね。偉いですね。このことを先生や親御さんに相談したりしましたか？
dialogue.English: I see... You're pushing through your pain and doing your best to go. That's very brave of you. Have you talked to your teachers or parents about this?

dialogue.content: 先生に相談して一度おさまりましたが、結局またいじめが始まるみたいな感じです
dialogue.English: I talked to a teacher and it stopped for a while, but in the end, it just started up again.

dialogue.content: もともと、いじめられてたから、親はそこまで関心？してないどうせ子どものいじめだからって
dialogue.English: Since I was bullied before, my parents aren't that... concerned? They figure it's just kids being kids.

dialogue.content: 一度は相談されたんですね。改善したいと思って行動されたのですね。小学校の時もとのことでしたが、その時も親御さんにも相談されたのですね？
dialogue.English: So you did talk to them once. You took action because you wanted things to change. You mentioned it happened in elementary school too; did you talk to your parents then as well?

dialogue.content: そうです。最初は担任にお話してくれたり色々してくれたけど最近はあんまりです
dialogue.English: Yes. At first they spoke with my homeroom teacher and did various things, but lately not so much.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。親御さんも行動してくれたけど、あまり改善は見られなかったと。。。
dialogue.English: I see. So your parents took action, but you didn't see much improvement...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 色々と考えたり、行動したりしたのですね。辛い中頑張っていますね。あなたは今の状況がどんなふうに変われば良いなと思いますか？もちろん完全にいじめがなくなればという思いが一番だと思いますが、少しでもわかってくれる人がいれば、や、環境が変わればいいな、など思うことはありますか？
dialogue.English: You've really thought about this and tried different things. You're trying so hard amidst this pain. How would you like your current situation to change? Of course, the best thing would be for the bullying to stop completely, but are there other things you wish for, like having at least one person who understands, or for your environment to change?

dialogue.content: 正直学校いきたくない
dialogue.English: Honestly, I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: 授業はいいけど休み時間が一番つらい
dialogue.English: Classes are fine, but break time is the hardest.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そう思うのは自然なことだと思います。休み時間が辛いのですね。親御さんに学校に行きたくない気持ちを伝えたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I think it's completely natural to feel that way. So break times are the most difficult. Have you ever told your parents that you don't want to go to school?

dialogue.content: 伝えたことがあるし、玄関出ないようにしたことがあるけど
dialogue.English: I have told them, and I've tried not to leave the house, but...

dialogue.content: 行きなってたたかれた
dialogue.English: I was hit and told to go.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったんですね。学校に行きたくないのに家でもそんなふうにたたかれてしまうと、余計に悲しいですよね。今あなたのことをわかってくれると思える人はいますか？
dialogue.English: That happened? It must be even more upsetting to be hit at home when you already don't want to go to school. Is there anyone you feel understands you right now?

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょ、わかりません
dialogue.English: I wonder... I don't know.

dialogue.content: 例えば、1年生の時に仲の良かった別のクラウのお友達や、担任の先生意外の学校の先生はどうですか？先生出なくても保健室の先生や用務員さんなど、お話しできそうな人はいますか？
dialogue.English: For example, what about your good friend from your first year who's in another class, or other teachers at school besides your homeroom teacher? Even if it's not a teacher, is there someone you might be able to talk to, like the school nurse or a janitor?

dialogue.content: ↑クラスです。すみません。
dialogue.English: I meant “class.” Sorry.

dialogue.content: クラス分かれていらいそんなにかかわりないし別のクラスだから生きにくい
dialogue.English: Since we were put in different classes, we haven't interacted much, and it's hard to go to another classroom.

dialogue.content: 行きにくい
dialogue.English: Hard to go.

dialogue.content: 保健室の先生もお話できるかどうか分からない、、結局一緒じゃないんかって思う
dialogue.English: I don't know if I can talk to the school nurse... I feel like it'll just be the same in the end.

dialogue.content: 用務員さんどこにいるかしらない
dialogue.English: I don't know where the janitor is.

dialogue.content: 別のクラスには行きづらいですよね。あとは、学校にはスクールカウンセラーという人がいて、悩みを聞いてくれたり解決に導いてくれる人がいるのですが、あなたの学校にもいますか？
dialogue.English: It's hard to go to another classroom, isn't it? Also, schools often have someone called a school counselor who listens to students' problems and helps find solutions. Does your school have one?

dialogue.content: 聞いたことない、、、
dialogue.English: I've never heard of one...

dialogue.content: もしいたら、先生とか教えてくれたかもだけど言ってなかったから多分いないと思う
dialogue.English: If there was one, maybe a teacher would have told me, but they didn't, so I guess we probably don't have one.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうだったんですね。もうすぐお時間になってしまうので、今日はここまでになってしまいます。お悩みの解決までお伝えできずにごめんなさい。あなたのいじめで辛い気持ちはとてもよくわかったし、これまでやってきた努力や行動はとても偉いなと思います。ただ、この問題はあなた1人で解決するより誰かに頼って解決法を探した方が良いと思います。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I see. Our time is almost up, so we'll have to stop here for today. I'm sorry that we couldn't get to a resolution for your problem. I understand very well how much pain this bullying is causing you, and I think the effort and actions you've taken so far are truly admirable. However, I believe this is a problem that would be better to solve by relying on someone rather than trying to handle it all by yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 例えば、学校以外の人や、さっきお話ししたことがないという保健の先生など一度尋ねてみても良いかなと思います。休み時間が辛いと話してくれていたので、休み時間に逃げ場としてまずは保健室にいってみるというのもできるかなと思いますが、どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: For example, I think it might be good to try asking someone outside of school, or perhaps the school nurse who you mentioned you haven't spoken to before. You said that break times are difficult, so maybe you could try going to the nurse's office as a safe place to escape to during breaks. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: 一度言ってみようと思います
dialogue.English: I think I'll try going once.

dialogue.content: あなたはこれまでも勇気を持って行動し、改善に向かおうとされてきているので、きっとうまく行くと思います。あと、親御さんとのお話しなのですが、あなたが辛い状況のなか、行くように勧めるのは、親御さんの愛情もあるかもしれないのですが、あなたにとっては余計に辛い状況になってしまうのではないかと思いました。今一度、あなたの辛い気持ちを親御さん（お父さん、お母さんのお話ししやすい方、ご兄弟でも良いかもしれません）にもう一度伝えてみても良いかなと思いました。親御さんにも真剣に改善にむけて行動してもらう必要があると感じました。
dialogue.English: You've already shown so much courage by taking action and trying to make things better, so I believe you can do it. Also, regarding your parents, while their pushing you to go to school might come from a place of love, I felt it might be making the situation even more painful for you. I was thinking it might be good to try one more time to convey your painful feelings to your parents (whichever one is easier to talk to, your father or mother, or maybe even a sibling). I feel it's necessary for your parents to also take serious action toward improving the situation.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: もし、それも言いづらいような状況ということでしたら、この続きからまたお話しできますので、いつでもご相談に来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: If that also feels too difficult to do, we can continue our conversation from here next time, so please feel free to come back and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: 母はかなり自己中心的なのでお話聞いてくれるか分かりませんがもう一度話してみます
dialogue.English: My mother is quite self-centered, so I'm not sure she'll listen, but I'll try talking to her again.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 学校に行くだけでも辛いのに、その気持ちを頑張ってお話し、ご相談してくれてありがとうございました。状況が改善し、あなたが安心して学校に行けるようになることを願っていますし、これからも必要であればサポートできればと思います。
dialogue.English: It's hard enough just to go to school, so thank you for gathering your strength to talk and consult with me about your feelings. I hope your situation improves and that you can go to school feeling safe. I'd like to continue supporting you if you need it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 本日はこれで終了とさせて頂きますね。ありがとうござました。
dialogue.English: We'll end our session here for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました！忌憚ないFBをお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today! Please give me your candid feedback.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました！とても勉強になりました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you! It was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.content: （終了ボタンおさせて頂きます！）
dialogue.English: (I'll press the end button now!)
